tagline: Design a product by choosing real patterns at each journey stage — with tradeoffs, conflicts, and a goal-guided assist.
disclaimer: Patterns and winners reflect opinionated design judgment on observable UX, not internal metrics. Built to be extended — add or AI-generate more industries.

conflictModel.rule: Flag a conflict when two chosen options sit on opposite poles of an axis (one >= 2 and another <= -2). Lower consistency per conflict.

screenTypes.photoGrid: 2-col grid of photo tiles with price/heart
screenTypes.dealList: list rows with discount badges + urgency text
screenTypes.filterList: results count banner + filter chips + result rows
screenTypes.mapView: map area with pins + cards below
screenTypes.listRows: plain list rows with thumbnail + lines
screenTypes.scoreBadge: large score chip + review count + urgency pill
screenTypes.badgeRow: row of verified/guarantee pills + assurance line
screenTypes.guestForm: few input fields + reassurance banner + button
screenTypes.oneClick: saved payment row + single prominent action button
screenTypes.reassureForm: calm copy + 'not charged yet' banner + request button
screenTypes.stampCard: row of stamp circles, some filled + progress line
screenTypes.savedGrid: grid of saved photo tiles with hearts + label
screenTypes.tierList: tier badge + list of unlocked perks/deals
screenTypes.feedFull: single full-screen item with side actions

designDirection: Editorial research-lab aesthetic: monochrome (near-black / off-white) with one restrained accent; grotesk + monospace type; UPPERCASE wide-tracked labels; index numbers; hairline rules; bracket [ ] and hexagon motifs. Use the per-industry icon (Lucide name) + index instead of emoji.
annotationSpec: Each option carries purpose (why this layout / what it is good for), tradeoff (its weakness), company, pattern. Render the in-Studio preview as a higher-fidelity mock with numbered callouts: 1 PURPOSE, 2 STRENGTH (derive from purpose+traits), 3 WEAKNESS (=tradeoff). Where purpose is absent, compose one from pattern + traits.
previewSpec: Render every phone preview ONLY from option.preview {company, pattern, header, metric, rows[4], cta}, laid out by option.screen. No hardcoded strings in any screen component. Title=company+pattern; section header=header; any stat=metric; all list/grid/card/chat/search items=rows; primary button=cta. Wallet chrome (balance/Send/Pay) allowed only when industry id is fintech, and its text must come from preview.
